services.name: tandem first
services.desc: Skydive Midwest is the largest skydiving operation in the Milwaukee area featuring a massive covered packing area, 80-foot elevated observation deck and beautiful, privately-owned airport along I-94. Located conveniently between Chicago and Milwaukee. Whether you are an experienced skydiver or a first-time, tandem skydive student, our facility is designed for your comfort and convenience. We are located at 13851 56th Rd. Sturtevant WI, 53177 -- only 60 miles north of Chicago and 30 miles south of Milwaukee. We are not only the closest skydiving center to Chicago, but the only skydiving center to have public transportation and a FREE shuttle service available. I-94W to Milwaukee; Exit #335.

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Here’s something you don’t hear from many dropzones: we love fun jumpers! What's a fun jumper? A fun jumper is a certified skydiver who is jumping purely for recreational fun! Fun jumpers are the heart and soul of a dropzone and we strive every day to cater to our wonderful community of committed skydivers. SDMW DZO, Keith George is an active, competitive jumper. On any given weekend, you can find him fun jumping, organizing or training with a team. By example, SDMW has grown and expanded it's skydiver base by offering more events, better organizers, ratings courses, excellent facilities and the best lift ticket prices in the area.
